intervals.method: 95% percentile circular-block bootstrap; conditional on this 250-observation sample. Not a next-day loss prediction interval.

controls.check: Position IDs unique; schema and asset types valid
Numeric values finite; bond sensitivities nonnegative
Factor dates unique and strictly increasing
Minimum history for rolling backtest available
Dataset provenance is shown below; no live freshness guarantee

backtest.note: Wilson assumes independent Bernoulli exceptions. Circular-block intervals resample observed sequences; sparse or all-zero exceptions can make them misleading. Independence p-values are asymptotic, not proof of adequacy.

provenance.label: Synthetic multi-asset
provenance.scope: Equity, bonds and EUR cash. All factor observations are synthetic.
provenance.calendar: Weekdays only; not an exchange calendar.
